_about: How a rotary embedding pairs the dimensions it rotates (ROADMAP M17.4; testbed/results/m15/PAIRING_CANDIDATE.md): 'split' rotates dimension i with i + d/2 (rotate_half, the Llama/NeoX convention), 'interleaved' rotates 2i with 2i+1 (GPT-J). A checkpoint rarely declares it in config.json; the reference implementation of its architecture does, in code. `keys` are the config keys that declare it when present; `architectures` is the convention per model_type from the transformers 5.17.0 modeling file (the reference consumer; file lines as evidence), used only when no key declares it. `kernels` names engine code paths that ignore the pairing up to a version (the retrospective on vllm#42016: the Triton MRoPE kernel hard-coded the split convention until #49906, 2026-07-28, in 0.27.0). A model_type not listed declares nothing: no decision (a convention entail cannot invent).

rope_interleave.ref: transformers 5.17.0 modeling_deepseek_v3.py L464: `if self.config.rope_interleave: apply_rotary_pos_emb_interleave` (L322); vLLM transformers_utils/configs/bailing_moe_v3_vl.py reads the same key

rope_interleaved.ref: the spelling some GLM-5 configs use (vLLM transformers_utils/configs/glm5_next.py: indexer_rope_interleave); read as the same declaration

is_neox_style.ref: vLLM's own name for the convention (rotary_embedding/base.py L35); a config that carries it (vLLM's DFlash loader stamps it, #51655) declares it

glm4.ref: modeling_glm4.py L150 rotate_half uses x[..., 0::2] / x[..., 1::2] and torch.stack; L179-180 cos/sin repeat_interleave(2)

glm.ref: modeling_glm.py L162 rotate_half interleaved; L191-192 repeat_interleave(2)

glm4v.ref: modeling_glm4v.py L503 rotate_half_llm (interleaved) for the text model; L265 rotate_half (split) is the vision tower's

glm4v_text.ref: the text model of glm4v (modeling_glm4v.py L503)

glm_ocr.ref: modeling_glm_ocr.py L127 rotate_half_llm (interleaved) for the text model; L335 rotate_half (split) is the vision tower's

glm_ocr_text.ref: the text model of glm_ocr (modeling_glm_ocr.py L127)

ernie4_5.ref: modeling_ernie4_5.py L115 rotate_half interleaved; L184-185 repeat_interleave(2)

cohere.ref: modeling_cohere.py L115 'we interleave() instead of cat()'; L175 rotate_half uses x[..., 1::2]

llama.ref: modeling_llama.py rotate_half: x[..., : x.shape[-1] // 2] and torch.cat((-x2, x1))

deepseek_v3.ref: configuration_deepseek_v3.py L114: rope_interleave defaults to True, and modeling_deepseek_v3.py L464 applies apply_rotary_pos_emb_interleave (L322) when it is; the repo's own configuration_deepseek.py (trust_remote_code) has no such key, so the default is the declaration there; `rope_interleave: false` declares split (L289 rotate_half). vLLM builds it interleaved (deepseek_v2.py is_neox_style=False). The first table row said split, from L289 alone: a mismatch the review caught before any run (M17.4 review, finding 9)

vllm.mrope_triton.applies_when: the MRoPE module dispatches to its CUDA/HIP kernel (CustomOp enabled: enforce_eager, ROCm, or +rotary_embedding in compilation_config.custom_ops); under the default compiled CUDA path forward_native honours is_neox_style. The adapter reads the module's dispatched forward (_forward_method) and passes mrope only when it is not forward_native
vllm.mrope_triton.ref: vllm/model_executor/layers/rotary_embedding/mrope.py: is_neox_style became a kernel constexpr in #49906 (2026-07-28, first in 0.27.0); before it the kernel paired dimensions split-wise for every model (vllm#42016 GLM-OCR, vllm#49290); dispatch: custom_op.py dispatch_forward / default_on
